newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: New proposal delays Rand Mines suspension.
newsitem.headline: New proposal delays Rand Mines suspension.

text.p: Rand Mines Ltd said on Thursday that its listings on the Johannesburg and London stock exchanges would neither be suspended on November 13, nor terminated on November 15 as was previously announced.

It said that a proposal, involving an offer for the company's ordinary shares, had been put to the directors which could result in the company not being wound-up pursuant to its final unbundling as was referred to in a shareholder circular on September 18.
The suspension and delisting of the company's shares would be postponed pending the outcome of the proposal.
Rand Mines listing on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange would be transferred to the Cash Companies sector with effect from November 18.
Shareholders are advised to exercise caution in their sharedealings until a further announcement.
Rand Mines said the proposal would not affect the unbundling of the company which was expected to become unconditional on November 13. An announcement could be expected on November 14.
Shareholders were also advised that the outcome of the litigation in respect of pensioners' medical aid contributions and the 1996 interim results were still awaited, the company said.
